# R1/N14 — Coarsest two-law LR/SL right-congruence repair; exact 10-state witness

Date: 2026-10-27. Status: AUTHOR MATHEMATICAL PROOF + EXECUTED EXACT RATIONAL CHECK; independent Research Driver review, Lean formalization, and native P000/X6 correspondence not completed.

## Frozen inputs and traceability

GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE_V1: canonical main 731ed46e667d116ae09e64b973a305f70bf58e37, including the active project route and verified P000 projection (canonical P000 Git blob 770e1b157fc10aab7b25d80c2cd52d6fcd07c9dc). Enterprise Math: scientific input main f7561d1d28105a608cecdf27730e6b4bbe09a23e. Project protocol: docs/PORTABLE_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md. Predecessors: research_notes/r1_n14_brc_iid_lr_polytope_all_horizons_20261027_r1/PROOF.md and research_notes/r1_n14_brc_lr_fiber_nonconvex_n3_20261027_r1/PROOF.md, VERIFY.py. No change to P000, protected ACTIVE worldview, ownership, or theorem admission.

## Exact model and narrow minimality definition

Let A be a finite common alphabet, N finite, and P,Q strictly positive cylinder laws on every ordered history h in A^t for 0<=t<=N. Write p_h(a)=P(ha)/P(h), q_h(a)=Q(ha)/Q(h), and r(h)=Q(h)/P(h). A declared time-typed compression x_t(h) is to be preserved. A repaired equivalence family E_t must meet all four conditions:

1. E_t refines x_t: E-equivalent histories have identical x.
2. E_t has constant likelihood ratio r in every fiber.
3. Labelled right congruence: h E_t g implies ha E_(t+1) ga separately for EVERY a in A. This guarantees deterministic update z(ha)=rho(z(h),a).
4. Strong lumpability under BOTH laws: for every E_(t+1) class B and h E_t g, the sums of p_h(a) and p_g(a) over symbols landing in B agree, and likewise the q sums.

"Coarsest" means the greatest equivalence relation among all families satisfying these four constraints, i.e. the least necessary number of repaired states at each level. No claim is made about policies carrying persistent hidden random selectors, quotients not updated deterministically under each visible symbol, observer-only rather than full-x preservation, or approximations.

## Backward exact construction

At horizon N, put two histories together exactly when their pairs (x_N(h),r(h)) agree.

For t from N-1 down to 0, with the next-level classes already fixed, assign each history h the tuple:

Sig_t(h) = (
  x_t(h), r(h),
  (class_(t+1)(ha)) for a in the FIXED order of alphabet A,
  (sum_{a: class_(t+1)(ha)=B} p_h(a)) for each next-level class B
).

Put h,g in the same t-class iff their signatures coincide. All comparisons are exact rational comparisons for rational input. The total input consists of finitely many nodes, so this single backward sweep terminates.

**Theorem 1 (validity and unique coarseness):** For positive P,Q, these equivalences are the unique coarsest admissible time-typed right-congruence repair, up to state renaming. The algorithm is exact for all finite N, and rational for rational input.

**Proof of validity:** Signature equality preserves x, r, the child class for each labelled a, and all P probabilities into next-state classes. It therefore satisfies conditions 1,2,3 and P-lumpability. To deduce Q-lumpability, let h be in parent class u of ratio r_u and B be a child class of ratio r_B. Then

  r_u * sum_{a:ha in B} q_h(a)
  = (Q(h)/P(h)) * sum_{a:ha in B} Q(ha)/Q(h)
  = sum_{a:ha in B} Q(ha)/P(h)
  = r_B * sum_{a:ha in B} P(ha)/P(h)
  = r_B * sum_{a:ha in B} p_h(a).                 (*)

The two positive ratios are fixed on u and B. Hence equal P mass into B forces equal Q mass into B. No separate Q test is logically needed (the executable checker includes one redundantly). At the terminal level there are no successors. QED for validity.

**Proof of coarseness:** Let E be ANY four-condition family. At N, E_N refines the computed class partition because it preserves x and LR. Suppose inductively E_(t+1) refines the computed next-level partition C_(t+1). If h E_t g, then x_t and r agree. The right-congruence property implies ha E_(t+1) ga for each a; so their computed child class IDs agree. Further, E-lumpability gives equal P mass into each finer E_(t+1) class; by summing those equalities over classes grouped in any C_(t+1) block, P mass into each C block agrees. Thus Sig_t(h)=Sig_t(g), meaning h C_t g. Reverse induction proves E_t is contained in C_t at every level. As C itself satisfies the requirements, C is the GREATEST admissible equivalence and uniquely coarsest. QED.

Note that this theorem establishes existence without assuming closure of arbitrary admissible partitions under a naive meet. The backward signature exhibits the greatest member directly. It does not imply an identically coarsest partition for weaker observation interfaces.

## Exact 40-prefix non-IID application

Alphabet A={0,1,2}, horizon N=3. Both P and Q use uniform draws (1/3,1/3,1/3) for the first and second symbol. The third-symbol P laws, conditional on FIRST symbol i, are:

  i=0 : (1/4, 1/4, 1/2);
  i=1 : (1/12, 3/4, 1/6);
  i=2 : (1/6, 1/2, 1/3).

Q third-symbol laws multiply these componentwise by r=(2,1,1/2), respectively:

  i=0 : (1/2, 1/4, 1/4);
  i=1 : (1/6, 3/4, 1/12);
  i=2 : (1/3, 1/2, 1/6).

All rows are strictly positive and normalized. For t<=2 the prefix LR is 1; for t=3 it is r_j according to last symbol j. The original deterministic recursive x is x0=root, x1=first symbol i, x2=*, x3=last symbol j (all time tagged), profile (1,3,1,3) = 8 states.

At t=3, x and LR force exactly three groups indexed by last j; each contains nine histories. At t=2, the per-symbol child class vector is the same for all histories, but the P probability of the terminal class j=0 differs between first symbols: 1/4, 1/12, 1/6. Thus SL FORBIDS merging different first-symbol predecessors. Every second-symbol history with the SAME first i has the same x, LR, child-class vector and P/Q row; hence the coarsest algorithm merges those three histories. Exactly THREE states are necessary and sufficient at t=2. At t=1, x already distinguishes the three i. At t=0 there is one root. Therefore the unique coarsest repair has the profile

  |Z_0|,|Z_1|,|Z_2|,|Z_3| = (1,3,3,3), TOTAL=10.

An explicit attaining repaired state is z0=root, z1=i, z2=i, z3=j, with time tags. Compared with original 8-state compression, only TWO states are restored; full ordered histories contain 1+3+9+27=40 nodes. This is a **minimality proof** because the three distinct time-two transition rows force the lower bound, while the explicit 10-state recursively updated model attains it. It is not merely a heuristic count.

## Common-policy two-law observation preservation

Once a repaired z satisfies LR and two-law SL, a standard positive BRC occupation-mass argument yields universal exact Markovization: given ANY single full-history randomized stop/decision policy used under both laws, let s(h) be its probability of survival to h and set w_P(h)=P(h)s(h). For a state u group all w_P(h) to define occupancy m_P(u) and action flows z_P(u,a) for each stop-decision or continuation action a. By SL these obey the compressed P transition recursion. Use the state action kernel pi_u(a)=z_P(u,a)/m_P(u) where m_P(u)>0, and any legal stop kernel otherwise. LR constancy implies P-to-Q mass ratio r_u within u. Identity (*) gives r_u K_Q(u,v)=r_v K_P(u,v). Inductively the SAME state policy under Q has state masses r_u m_P(u) and action masses r_u z_P(u,a). Therefore both P and Q terminal joint laws (T,z(H_T),D) match those of the full-history policy for ALL finite random policies, no persistent hidden selector needed. Every terminal readout factoring through z inherits the equality.

## Actually executed exact evidence

VERIFY.py was executed using CPython fractions.Fraction on ALL 40 prefixes. It constructs the backward signatures, checks both conditional kernels and normalization, examines every ordered within-block pair for x/LR/right-congruence/two-law SL, verifies (*) on each relevant transition, and checks one genuinely second-symbol-dependent randomized full-history policy against its statewise P-flow Markovization under both P and Q. RESULT.json is the executed output. Exact result is PASS_EXACT_FRACTION, minimal profile 1/3/3/3, total 10. The theorem for arbitrary finite N follows from the proof above; a single finite instance does not independently prove it.

Observer scope: all original (T,x,D) readouts factor through z. Observers asking for second symbol at time 2, or FIRST symbol at terminal time 3, do NOT generally factor through this ten-state quotient, and need more residual state. A weaker coarse terminal observer might permit a smaller representation after dropping the requirement to retain all of original x and/or symbolwise deterministic update: not covered here.

## Prior art and novelty boundary

This is a finite-horizon, positive two-law LR-typed specialization/adaptation of classical probabilistic bisimulation, strong lumpability and partition refinement; it is NOT claimed to be the first discovery of partition minimization. Relevant antecedents: Larsen and Skou, Bisimulation Through Probabilistic Testing, POPL 1989, DOI 10.1145/75277.75307; Desharnais, Edalat and Panangaden, Bisimulation for Labelled Markov Processes, Information and Computation 2002, DOI 10.1006/inco.2001.2962; Jean-Claude Fernandez, An Implementation of an Efficient Algorithm for Bisimulation Equivalence, 1990, https://cadp.inria.fr/publications/Fernandez-90.html. None of these bibliographic references substitutes for the specific proof above.

NEXT TASK: characterize observer-only minimal sufficiency when preserving only (T,o(x),D), perhaps without preserving full original x, and determine whether a unique coarsest quotient still exists. Keep native ownership, independent review, Lean, and X6 mapping as separate pending obligations.
